title.zh: 菲律宾央行限制银行向主要加密平台Coins.ph转账
title.en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph

current_state.zh: BSP 对 Coins.ph 的执法行动持续，可能吊销牌照；通过 DCPay Philippines 的存款限制仍在且非临时；合规高管离职增加了运营与监管压力。
current_state.en: BSP enforcement against Coins.ph continues with potential license revocation; deposit restrictions via DCPay Philippines remain and are not time-bound; compliance leadership departures add operational and regulatory pressure.

updates.title_zh: 菲律宾央行限制银行向主要加密平台Coins.ph转账
updates.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph
updates.what_changed_zh: 菲律宾中央银行部分暂停了向DCPay Philippines的InstaPay和PESONet入账银行转账，DCPay Philippines是当地领先加密平台Coins.ph的电子货币运营商，而转出转账以及单独持牌的Betur Inc.交易实体不受影响。
updates.what_changed_en: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.
updates.current_state_zh: 菲律宾中央银行部分暂停了向DCPay Philippines的InstaPay和PESONet入账银行转账，DCPay Philippines是当地领先加密平台Coins.ph的电子货币运营商，而转出转账以及单独持牌的Betur Inc.交易实体不受影响。
updates.current_state_en: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.

updates.title_zh: 菲律宾最大加密交易所Coins.ph据称面临央行监管行动
updates.title_en: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action
updates.what_changed_zh: CoinDesk 报道称，BSP 对 Coins.ph 的执法行动与其服务受限离岸博彩运营商有关，可能包括吊销牌照；对 DCPay Philippines 的存款限制据报道并非临时措施，且 BSP 与 Coins.ph 均未回应置评。
updates.what_changed_en: CoinDesk reports that BSP enforcement against Coins.ph is tied to serving restricted offshore gambling operators and could include license revocation; the DCPay Philippines deposit restrictions are reported as not time-bound, and neither BSP nor Coins.ph commented.
updates.current_state_zh: BSP 对 DCPay Philippines 的入站 InstaPay/PESONet 转账限制仍在，且据报道该限制并非临时措施；Coins.ph 因涉嫌服务受限离岸博彩运营商而面临更广泛的 BSP 执法行动，并可能被吊销牌照。
updates.current_state_en: BSP's inbound InstaPay/PESONet transfer restrictions on DCPay Philippines remain, reportedly not time-bound; Coins.ph faces broader reported BSP enforcement over allegedly serving restricted offshore gambling operators, with potential license revocation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coins.ph, the Philippines' largest crypto exchange with more than 18 million customers, is reportedly facing central bank enforcement over serving restricted offshore gambling operators — involving deposit restrictions and a potential license revocation.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coins.ph, the Philippines' largest crypto exchange with more than 18 million customers, is reportedly facing central bank enforcement over serving restricted offshore gambling operators — involving deposit restrictions and a potential license revocation.

updates.title_zh: 菲律宾最大CEX Coins ph或遭央行严厉处罚，严重情况下可能被吊销牌照
updates.title_en: 菲律宾最大CEX Coins ph或遭央行严厉处罚，严重情况下可能被吊销牌照
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充称 Coins.ph 多名合规高管离职，包括首席合规官及反洗钱监控负责人，并披露其拥有超 1800 万用户、日现货交易量约 5000 万美元、控制菲律宾约 75%-80% 比索兑稳定币流动性。
updates.what_changed_en: New reporting adds that multiple Coins.ph compliance executives have departed, including the chief compliance officer and AML monitoring head, and discloses it has over 18 million users, about $50 million daily spot volume, and controls roughly 75%-80% of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin liquidity.
updates.current_state_zh: BSP 对 Coins.ph 的执法行动持续，可能吊销牌照；通过 DCPay Philippines 的存款限制仍在且非临时；合规高管离职增加了运营与监管压力。
updates.current_state_en: BSP enforcement against Coins.ph continues with potential license revocation; deposit restrictions via DCPay Philippines remain and are not time-bound; compliance leadership departures add operational and regulatory pressure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Philippines' largest crypto exchange Coins.ph is facing BSP punitive measures — including possible license revocation — over allegations it served restricted offshore gambling firms, after the central bank already curtailed deposits via its main wallet operator DCPay Philippines.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Philippines' largest crypto exchange Coins.ph is facing BSP punitive measures — including possible license revocation — over allegations it served restricted offshore gambling firms, after the central bank already curtailed deposits via its main wallet operator DCPay Philippines.
